scale_note: Same unit system as the flat set: frankenstein_folded is ~430 units tall; the unfolded version is the same scale (~850 tall). Bats and candies are at the same scale as the Frankenstein monster; scribble at the crab's scale.

frankenstein_hinge.description: Hinge is the bottom edge of the head (y=205 in both files). In frankenstein_unfolded, part-inside spans y 205..622 and part-body starts at y 622. In frankenstein_folded, part-body has transform translate(0,-417) so its top edge meets the head at y=205, and part-inside is omitted. Geometry of part-head and part-body is identical in both files.
frankenstein_hinge.animate: To unfold by fraction t (0..1): scale part-inside by (1, t) about y=205 (or reveal/clip it from y=205 down to 205+417*t), and translate part-body by (0, -417*(1-t)). Draw order: part-inside, part-body, part-head.

sprites.character: Frankenstein monster, unfolded: head and body pulled apart to reveal a long green inside with a giant open red mouth, rows of thin teeth top and bottom, a long red tongue and a black two-lobed shape at the back of the throat
Red crab in a brown cowboy hat with a black star
sprites.notes: Facing the viewer; symmetric enough to flip. Wiggle groups: claw-left, claw-right, leg-l1..l3, leg-r1..r3 (each leg = upper segment + pointed lower segment). part-hat sits on top of part-body.

Doodle: orange wrapped candy with lumpy crinkled wrapper ends (top-left of the sheet). Outlined in darker orange, not black, as he drew it in orange only
Doodle: orange wrapped candy with triangular wrapper ends (mid-left of the sheet). Outlined in darker orange, not black
Effect: the loose orange line scribble and brown hatching around the crab (sand/dust kicked up). Coloured line only, no black outline. Groups: scribble-line (orange), scribble-hatch (brown)
